literal: "We are poor," saying, coveting they will not do, the senses conquered, meanness-without vision having they.
translation: Those who have conquered their senses and possess a vision free from meanness will not covet others' wealth, even when thinking, "We are destitute."
modern: "நாம் வறியவர்" என்று நினைத்து, பிறர் பொருளை விரும்பும் செயலைச் செய்ய மாட்டார்கள், ஐம்புலன்களையும் வென்ற குற்றமற்ற அறிவுடையவர்கள்.
explanation: This couplet explains that people of pure, flawless wisdom who have mastered their five senses will never resort to coveting others' property, even in times of extreme poverty. The word 'புலம்' refers to the five senses, and 'வென்ற' means conquered, indicating self-control. 'புன்மை இல் காட்சி' refers to a perception or vision that is free from the blemish of ignorance or meanness. Such individuals do not let temporary material deprivation ('இலம்') compromise their integrity.
